facts.premium: Major upper-Isan commercial city; trade/service wages above rural norm, below national.
facts.skill_gap: Service and retail demand exceeds local skilled supply in the city; rural areas low-skill.
anchors: Udon city — upper-Isan commercial, retail & logistics hub
Laos-border trade (Nong Khai/Vientiane corridor) and remittance economy
workers: Retail, trade, logistics and service workers in the city
Rice and cassava farmers in rural districts
Informal traders, vendors and gig riders
impacts: Strong retail/logistics base diversifies income beyond farming.
Cross-border trade and Lao spending support the city economy.
Rural districts exposed to cassava price falls and rain-fed harvest risk.
High consumer-credit penetration in the city can strain repayment.
Large migrant population; transfers underpin household cash flow.
